name: Musikfest Berlin 2026
description: Marking the 75th anniversary of the Berliner Festspiele, Musikfest Berlin opens with György Ligeti's opera Le Grand Macabre—a rarely performed anti-opera inspired by Bruegel and Ghelderode, offering a vehement pastiche on totalitarian rule, mismanagement, and corruption. The 36-event festival features more than 60 works by around 40 composers, performed by over 65 international soloists and 30+ instrumental and vocal ensembles from Finland, Spain, the USA, Switzerland, Austria, South Africa, England, Japan, and Germany—including the Vienna Philharmonic, the London Symphony Orchestra, and Chineke! Orchestra with Cape Town Opera.
